answer_1.quote: In this study, we introduce a new open-domain long-term dialogue dataset, SHARE, which includes not only personas and personal event information but also information about memories shared between two speakers.

answer_2.quote: We conduct an automatic evaluation using a comprehensive set of metrics, including BLEU-3/4, ROUGE (ROUGE-1/2/L), BERTscore, Distinct-1/2 (Dist) and PPL.

answer_3.quote: We further conduct a GPT-4o assisted evaluation based on the following criteria: Coherence (Coh.): measures the consistency and logical connection of responses within a session. Engagingness (Eng.): assesses the speaker's ability to maintain the annotator's interest for a long-term dialogue. Closeness (Clo.): determines how well the two participants know each other... Reflectiveness (Ref.): evaluates how well the dialogue reflects the relationship indicated in the memory set.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluations through Amazon Mechanical Turk(AMT) to highlight the differences between SHARE and SHARE (w/o shared memory).
answer_4.guideline: We ask 20 annotators to evaluate each conversation based on the following criteria: • Closeness: In this criterion, we ask annotators to assess whether a response reflects the speakers' familiarity, shared history, or understanding... • Engagingness: we ask the annotators to judge whether a response reveals emotional depth, relational tension, or moments of personal significance... • Coherence: This criterion examines whether each response naturally connects to the preceding statements...
